title: Mushroom, Taleggio and Fontina Sheet-Tray Pizza
changes_from_base: Browned mixed mushrooms with rosemary and garlic replace the tomato sauce, and a creamy layer of cottage cheese with fontina, Taleggio and parmesan stands in for plain mozzarella on a rectangular tray-baked crust.
summary: Sheet-tray pizza with sautéed mixed mushrooms and rosemary over a creamy cottage cheese layer, three melted cheeses and a scattering of chives.
equipment: rimmed baking tray, about 30 x 40 cm

ingredients.item: mixed mushrooms (such as chestnut, shiitake and king trumpet), sliced about 6 mm thick
fine sea salt or table salt
pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, at room temperature
Taleggio, rind cut off, torn into small pieces

steps.title: Heat Oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 260 °C with a shelf at the lowest position and brush the tray with 30 ml oil.

steps.title: Cook Mushrooms
steps.text: Heat the remaining 30 ml oil in a frying pan over medium-high until shimmering, add mushrooms (340 g sliced), garlic (3 cloves chopped), rosemary (1½ tsp), pepper (½ tsp) and salt (¼ tsp), cook about 10 min until browned.

steps.title: Shape Dough
steps.text: On a lightly floured worktop, press and roll the dough (450 g) to about 38 x 28 cm and lift onto the tray.

steps.title: Build Topping
steps.text: Spread cottage cheese (170 g) evenly, scatter fontina (115 g grated), add mushrooms, then tear over Taleggio (115 g), scatter parmesan (30 g grated).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 13-15 min, turning the tray halfway, until the crust is golden and cheese is browned in spots.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Cool 5 min on a rack, scatter chives (1 tbsp chopped) if using and slice.

tips: Cooking the mushrooms separately removes excess water so the finished pizza stays crisp rather than soggy
A mix of chestnut, shiitake and king trumpet mushrooms gives more complex flavour than a single variety.
safety: If anyone eating is pregnant, choose pasteurised Taleggio and fontina; check the labels.
storage: Cool completely, then keep chilled for up to 2 days and reheat gently in a low oven wrapped in foil if needed. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
